name: serializeDeserialize
description: Serialization encodes a tree into a linear format (e.g. preorder traversal with null markers). Deserialization reconstructs the tree from that encoding. Both operations are O(n).
aim: Convert a binary tree to a string (serialize) and reconstruct the exact same tree from that string (deserialize). Used to persist tree data structures or transmit them over a network.
howItWorks: Serialize: DFS preorder traversal — record each node's value and 'null' for missing nodes
Deserialize: split string by delimiter, reconstruct tree recursively
Each 'null' in the string means no child at that position
Preorder ensures parent always appears before children — enables one-pass reconstruction

time.averageCase: Linear scan of all n nodes
time.worstCase: All n nodes must be processed

complexity.spaceDescription: O(n) for serialized string + O(h) call stack

realWorld: Redis RDB files: serialize in-memory data structures to disk
LevelDB: persist B-tree structure to disk
Distributed systems: send tree data over the network
Deep learning frameworks: save model computation graphs
whenToUse: Saving tree state to disk or database
alternatives: JSON serialization: more readable but slower
Protobuf: binary format, faster than JSON
